title: P2P message protocol for mental poker rounds
description: Wire protocol for mental poker: EncryptedDeck, DecryptionShare, KeyReveal message types. Rides on WebSocket or P2P. Hash chaining, rate limiting, size bounds (52 cards × 256B ciphertexts ≈ 13KB per shuffle step).
close_reason: ShuffleDeck/DecryptionShare/KeyReveal action types, ShuffleComplete/CardDealt/KeyRevealed/VerificationComplete event types, mental_poker_data field on Action. Both Rust and Python.
